messages:
vikram: Quick cross-check — planning to canary aurora-13b-mqa with RoPE scale=1.02 + sliding_window=1024. Need a quick eyes-on for weights path, tokenizer oddities, and attn impl compatibility. Weights: gs://redwood-weights/aurora/13b/mqa-v2/ckpt-2026-03-15.tar.lz4

sara: @vikram :eyes: confirming infra can mount that path, will validate checksum and storage class. any specific decoder config i should expect?

vikram: Config I'm going to apply (short):
```
model_variant: aurora-13b-mqa-v2
rope: {base_scale: 1.02, mode: "rescale"}
attn_impl: "fused_flash_if_avail"
sliding_window: 1024
kv_cache_ttl_seconds: 300
quant: int8
```
Note: we saw attention mismatch in earlier runs when attn_impl fell back to the generic kernel.

max: Quick heads-up — in 13b-quant testbeds we observed tokenizer producing duplicate BOS for chunked inputs when pad_to_multiple_of was set. Long windows + sliding chunking triggered it. Recommend forcing pad_to_multiple_of: null for canary.

jen: +1 on tokenizer change. Also run with small prompt that reproduces RoPE drift: repeated "Hello" * 512, see logits for position 512 vs 513. If mismatch appears, fallback to rope_scale=1.0 and re-run.

vikram: Good catch. I'll set tokenizer.pad_to_multiple_of = null and include the stress prompt. Sara — can you confirm the mount + checksum? If storage class is nearline, we might see cold-open latency impacting startup.

sara: Mounts OK. Checksum matches sha256: a3f5...c9f. Storage class = standard. Cold-open shouldn't be an issue. Will also pre-warm the layer by fetching the first 2 shards.

max: Also check model config for multi-query vs grouped-query flags. MQA math changes attention memory layout; if attn_impl expects MQA but model is GQA-configured you'll get subtle kv-index misalign. Share the config from the repo?

vikram: Repo path: https://git.internal/redwood/models/aurora/13b/mqa-v2/config.yaml
Snippet in case the link is blocked:
```
attention: {heads: 40, head_dim: 64, query_grouping: 1} # 1 => MQA
gqa: false
```
I think this variant was converted to true MQA (grouping=1) during quant conversion.

jen: If grouping=1 then attn kernels must be built for MQA. deploy-bot will report kernel fallback. Speaking of which...

deploy-bot: Started canary job 1972468000-aurora13b-mqa on pool-gpu-x1. Canary ID: canary-1972468000. Streaming logs at https://logs.redwood/canary/canary-1972468000

max: Look for these log markers when it starts: 
- "Using fused_flash_attn v2" 
- "KV layout: mqa" 
- "RoPE rescale applied: 1.02"
If any of those are missing, abort and collect a core dump.

vikram: Running the smoke now with batch 4, seq_len 1024, prompt stress. Will also enable analytic hook to capture per-layer attention norms.

sara: Pre-warm done, shards downloaded, sha256 matches. Starting canary node now.

jen: If you hit tokenization dupes, run this quick script to reproduce locally:
```python
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.load('aurora-13b')
prompt = 'Hello ' * 512
tok = t.encode(prompt)
print(tok[:10], tok[-10:], len(tok))
```
If you see extra BOS or duplicate leading tokens, open a tokenizer-issue and tag @max.

vikram: Canary logs: "Using fused_flash_attn v2" present, "KV layout: mqa" present, RoPE line: "RoPE rescale applied: 1.02". Initial decode looks fine. Tokenizer check shows no duplicate BOS in smoke.

max: Nice. Can you also sanity-check latency p95 for the first 100 requests (cold-start) and after 30s? Sliding-window can spike p95 on initial bursts.

vikram: p95 cold = 180ms, after 30s = 62ms. TTL eviction not triggered. No attn exceptions.

jen: Great. Next step: roll out to 10% traffic with automatic fallback to aurora-7b-mqa if any attn kernel fallback occurs or if p95 > 250ms for 2 consecutive minutes. Add escalation to eng-runtime on-call if regression hits.

vikram: I'll set rollout policy now. Adding canary note: "fallback: model=aurora-7b-mqa, trigger: kernel_fallback OR p95>250ms x120s"

sara: I've added the pre-warm step to the deploy recipe. Also updated infra alerting rule for GS latency.

max: Filing a small follow-up ticket for tokenizer edge-case testing across chunked sliding windows — marking as low priority but please include in next sprint if we see any regressions.

vikram: Thanks all. Closing this thread after monitoring for 24h. If anything odd, I'll re-open and paste logs. :thumbsup:
